extracted.name: Microwave orange & soy salmon parcels
extracted.description: Gently steam the fish in baking parchment to guarantee a perfectly cooked piece of microwaved salmon. Enjoy this meal for two with sticky rice and pak choi
ingredient_lines: 1 red chilli finely sliced (deseeded if you like)
15g piece of ginger peeled and cut into matchsticks
instruction_lines: Combine the soy sauce, chilli, ginger, spring onions, orange juice and honey in a bowl. Cut out two large squares from a sheet of baking parchment, and put a salmon fillet and half the pak choi in the middle of each. Bring the parchment up over the fish, pinch and fold the corners together and transfer the parcels to a plate. Divide the sauce between the parcels, then fold the ends in to seal well.
Microwave on high for 4-5 mins until the salmon is tender. Pour the sauce over the fish and serve alongside sticky rice, if you like.
